subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• When teachers post about their work on social media, they may inadvertently share confidential information about students.
• Dr. Tigist Mengistu conducted a study to determine how many teacher preparation programs have policies addressing social media use.
• Mengistu and her research team analyzed 95 program websites, reviewing publicly available faculty and student handbooks.
• Only eighteen programs had guidelines that specifically mentioned social media, and only seven provided clear definitions of appropriate use.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the study's methodology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The policies of 95 teacher preparation programs are publicly accessible online, according to research by Dr. Tigist Mengistu.
choices.B: To determine how many teacher preparation programs have social media policies, Dr. Tigist Mengistu and her team analyzed the websites and handbooks of 95 programs.
choices.C: Out of 95 teacher preparation programs, only eighteen had policies that mentioned social media, and only seven provided clear definitions of appropriate use.
choices.D: Dr. Tigist Mengistu and her research team wanted to know how many teacher preparation programs have social media policies to protect student privacy.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence effectively emphasizes Mengistu's methodology: analyzing the websites and handbooks of 95 teacher preparation programs for social media policies.
